description: Apple's export compliance for the app's iOS builds: the person's answers about the app's encryption (kept in Ploa), whether they need an encryption declaration at Apple and which document (a CCATS for proprietary algorithms; the French encryption declaration when it's sold in France), the declaration Ploa made and Apple's review state, the version's build's answer, what the Info.plist should say, and what's left with who does it. Includes each question in words to ask the person. Read-only.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

fresh.description: Ask Apple again instead of the copy from the last two minutes.

name: ploa_encryption_get
title: Read the app's export compliance
